goal: Get a mesh drawn in a registered scene
without: Without box.material (factories leave it null) the mesh is added and registered with no error and is never drawn.
Without any camera the mesh is still drawn but the scene uniforms (view-projection, fog) are never written and stay zero.
createDefaultCamera called before the meshes are added frames nothing (radius 1 at the origin) and does not refit later.

goal: Make a directional light cast a mesh's shadow onto the ground
without: Without sun.shadowGenerator = sg (creating sg does not set it, nor does addToScene(scene, sg)) no shadow map is drawn and the ground draws unshadowed.
Without setShadowTaskCasterMeshes no shadow pass runs; only meshes in that list cast.
receiveShadows set after registration is ignored: the ground keeps drawing without shadow.
With registerScene instead of registerSceneWithShadowSupport no shadow pass runs.

goal: Group meshes under a node to move, hide and remove them together
steps:
const group = createTransformNode("group", 2, 0, 0);
setParent(box, group); // keeps box's world position
addToScene(scene, group); // adds box as well
group.position.x = 4; // box follows
setMeshVisible(group, false); // hides box too
removeFromScene(scene, group); // removes box too
without: With box.parent = group instead of setParent, box keeps its local position and follows, but is not put in group.children, so addToScene, setMeshVisible and removeFromScene on the group do not reach it.
Adding box yourself as well as the group puts it in scene.meshes twice and draws it twice.

goal: Hide a mesh for a while and show it again
without: With removeFromScene instead, the mesh is disposed: its GPU buffers are destroyed once the next frame is submitted, and addToScene of it then throws ("cannot be added: it was disposed"). Added back sooner, it does not throw, but its buffers are destroyed all the same and it stays in the draw list with them: create it again.

goal: Change a light's brightness or colour while the scene runs
without: Plain writes (lamp.intensity = 3, lamp.diffuse[1] = 0, lamp.range = 5) are not uploaded until a light in the scene (this one or another) moves or gets a setLight* call, which rewrites the whole lights buffer; a later setLightIntensity with the value already written does nothing.
setLightDiffuseColor on a hemispheric light throws a TypeError: its colour fields are diffuseColor and groundColor, not diffuse.

goal: Draw many copies of one mesh with thin instances and edit them
without: Without flushThinInstances an in-place edit of m is not uploaded until the next addThinInstance or removeThinInstance. addThinInstance copies into a new array: edit box.thinInstances.matrices after it, as edits of m are then lost.
removeThinInstance(box, i) moves the last instance into slot i, so that instance's index changes.
setThinInstanceColor before setThinInstanceColors throws a TypeError; instances added beyond the colour array's length get no colour, silently.

goal: Add fog and change it while the scene runs (Standard material)
without: scene.fog = {...} instead of setFog builds the fog shader code but leaves the fog uniforms at 0 (mode 0).
setFog first called after registerScene writes the uniforms, but the meshes' pipelines have no fog code.
An in-place edit (scene.fog.end = 50) is not uploaded while the camera stays still; it is uploaded at the next camera move.

goal: Keep one light from lighting one mesh
without: Set after registration, the exclusion is not applied (the mesh stays lit by that light) until the mesh moves or a light is added to or removed from the scene.

goal: Give thin instances to a mesh that is already drawing
without: Without assigning a new material object (box.material = box.material is not enough) the mesh keeps drawing one plain copy.
A new mesh given thin instances before addToScene into a running scene draws them once its build has run, not on the first frame.

goal: Switch shadows off and on while the scene runs
steps:
setShadowGeneratorEnabled(sg, false); // no shadow pass, darkness 1
setShadowGeneratorEnabled(sg, true);
without: removeFromScene(scene, sg) instead unlinks it: sun.shadowGenerator becomes undefined and the shadow pass stops.
A generator first created and linked after registerSceneWithShadowSupport has its map drawn, but receivers built earlier never sample it.

goal: Make a mesh added later cast a shadow
without: With addToScene alone the new mesh is drawn in colour but not into the shadow map.

goal: Use more than 16 lights in a scene
without: Without setMaxLights, lights after the 16th in scene.lights are left out of the lights buffer and light nothing, with no error.
